integrity: The integral eigenlattice index, quotient, Frobenius conjugacy normal forms, and point formulas are independently recomputed by an included exact SymPy verifier; numerical q checks are illustrative and not used as the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite-field torus forms arising from an étale four-point projective frame; odd characteristic table, not arbitrary six-line arrangements, not a classification of the full unipotent factor. Published general Picard machinery is credited; priority remains provisional.
title: The index-sixteen integral gluing in the Picard torus of a complete quadrangle
